$about: Mood targets an export must land in and form notes that describe the reference, widened from the measured examples (see examples/*/profile.json). Run: node ../kit/measure.mjs export.mp4 --sample-every 1 --scene 0.2 --out p.json && node ../kit/check.mjs p.json targets.json

durationSeconds.why: a short film; the example runs 42 s

shots.count.why: few, long shots; the example has 4 shots (3 hard cuts) with dissolves inside

shots.medianSeconds.why: each shot lingers; the example's median is 7.7 s

picture.yavg.why: bright window light; the example averages 167

picture.ylow.why: soft, lifted shadows; the example's average low is 116

loudness.integratedLufs.why: music-only film for social; the example is −16.9
